title: Why Are There Two Koreas? | The History of  Korea
description:
Why are there TWO Koreas? How did one country become North Korea and South Korea?Korea was once a unified nation, but Japanese colonial rule, the end of World War II, Cold War rivalries and the Korean Warchanged the future of the Korean Peninsula.

In this animated history video, we explore Korea's journey from its historical roots to the division of the peninsula, theestablishment of two separate governments, and the conflict that continues to shape the region today.

IN THIS VIDEO:

• A brief history of Korea• Japanese colonial rule (1910–1945)• What changed after World War II in 1945

• The 38th Parallel and the division of Korea• The roles of the United States and Soviet Union

• The establishment of North Korea and South Korea in 1948• The Korean War (1950–1953)

• Why the two Koreas remain dividedONE PENINSULA. TWO STATES. A HISTORY THAT CHANGED THE WORLD.
